detail.longDescription:
You can delete the build step that sprays soft hyphens into your text. hyphens: auto finished its 30 months in March, and the dictionaries live in the browser.

Before, generated markup with every break point baked in:

Silben­trennung

After:

article { hyphens: auto; }

plus lang="de", or whatever applies, on the markup.
